svg.title: rEach and Teach: who may do what
svg.desc: A matrix of ten assets against five parties: student, AI agent, rEach, Teach and instructors. Each cell says whether that party owns or decides, has a limited role, has no access or is refused.
svg.text: Ten things worth protecting, five parties, and one answer in every cell.
what rEach learns of the student
The Teach column states outcomes only. How the server does it stays private.
